description.text: Specialty Education Objective The International class on economics of Wuhan University is particularly designed for the in-school international students. We aim at cultivating students’ adaptability, practical ability, strategic thinking and decision-making ability in order to meet the needs. Our program serves as a direct steppingstone towards employment and continuously provides enterprising and innovative high-level personnel dedicated in economic work. Length of Schooling and credit requirements Length of Schooling: Four years in general. Credit Requirements: 140 credits are required for graduation and degree conferring. 84 credits are required from compulsory courses (including general education compulsory courses, foundation compulsory courses and major compulsory courses as well as the thesis and the graduation practice), and 56 credits are required from elective courses (including general education elective courses, foundation elective courses and major elective courses). Of which 6 credits are for thesis and 2 credits are for graduate practice as well as 33 credits must be attained in general education elective courses. Degree Granting Those who met the criteria will be granted a bachelor's degree in economics. Core Courses Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Accounting, Statistics , Management, Money and Banking , Econometrics , Development Economics, Public Finance, Taxation, International Economics , International Business , Finance Economics, International Finance, Investment and Insurance, etc. Special curriculum were arranged to meet the needs of international students. For example, cross-cultural relationships and learning skills, the study on contemporary Chinese economy, China 's foreign trade , business Chinese, and trade and practical writing on economy & trade, etc. Graduation Requirements and Other Necessary Instructions Students, who complete all courses and practices, finish the regulated credits within qualified scores and submit an eligible graduation thesis will be granted graduation. For other graduation requirements not specifically stipulated in this paper, please reference to the relevant provisions of Wuhan University, School of Economics and Management, and international student institute.

duration.text: The Economics at Wuhan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2291 USD/per year ￥ 16500 CNY/per year

materials.text: . Certificate of HSK (No need for English-medium program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport Above the age of 18 and under the age of 30 Those who apply for the study of liberal arts and have passed at least HSK Examination Band 6, can directly start their study in the relevant colleges or departments; those who fail to pass the examination can at first apply for their study of Chinese Language for one year in Wuhan University before their study in the relevant colleges or departments.
